title: Haaye bazar hai zainab hai khule sar hai
body:
HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
NA RAHA KOI GHAREEBOUN KA SAHARA,, SATH MEIN ABID E BIMAR HAI TANHA,, SARI SAIDANIYAN ROTI HAIN TADAP KAR.. AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
<<MINI>>
--HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR--
<<DIVIDER>>
QASIM-O-AUN-O-MOHAMMED GAYE MAARE,, AB NA ABBAS HAI JO AAKEY BACHALEY,, NOOKEY NAIZA PA LAHO MEIN SAR-O-SARWAR.. AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
<<MINI>>
--HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR--
<<DIVIDER>>
BAS YEHI RAH MAIN BEWOUN KE THE NAALE,, KAASH ABBAS HAME CHOOD NA JATEY,, SAR SE ISTARHA SE CHINTI NAHI CHADAR.. AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
<<MINI>>
--HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR--
<<DIVIDER>>
HAAL-E-ZIANAB PA KOIE RAHEM NA KHAYA,, BINTE ZEHRA PA HAR EK ZULM HAI DHAYA,, AIK DIL PAR HAIN LIYE DAAG BAHATAR.. AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
<<MINI>>
--HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR--
<<DIVIDER>>
POUNCHA JIS WAQT YE DARBAR HAIN KUNBA,, SUB TAMASHAIE SE DARBAAR SAJA THA,, SHARAM SE ROPADI ABBAS KI QAHAR.. AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
<<MINI>>
--HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR--
<<DIVIDER>>
DHOOP SHIDDATH KI THI WO MEELOUN KA RASTA ,, HAL KODHOUN KI AZEYAT SE BURA THA,, SHUKAR KARTE RAHE BAS ABID-E-MUZTAR AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
<<MINI>>
--HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR--
<<DIVIDER>>
AYE SOHAIL AB TO QALAM ROOK KHUDRA,, SUNKE NOUHA YE TERA ROTI HAI ZAHRA ,, BAIN HAIN AAJ YE JO SUB KE LABOUN PAR.. AUR GHERE HUE HAR SIMTH SITAM GAR
<<MINI>>
--HAYE BAZAR HAI ZAINAB HAI KHULE SAR--
